title: "Motion Tracking" feature in S21 phone not working
symptom: Motion Tracking feature in xDrip+ does not work on Samsung Galaxy S21 5G / Android 11, while it worked on Samsung Galaxy S9 / Android 9. It is automatically disabled with a note that it may be incompatible with the phone.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It suggests possible permission issues (Activity Recognition, Change system setting) and Android 10 changes to the Activity API, but no confirmed cause.
fix: The thread does not provide a confirmed fix. A user noted that 'Change system setting' permission was not allowed on the new phone and was testing if allowing it helps, but no outcome is reported. The issue was closed without resolution.
evidence_quote: But then I noticed that "Change system setting" was not "Allow permissions" in the new phone and allowed in the old phone. I am now testing with that if it helps.
